description: Repair a tagged PDF's form to PDF/UA-1: enclose Widget annotations in Form structure elements (7.18.4-1), set /Tabs S on the affected pages (7.18.3-1), and give fields alternate names /TU (7.18.1-3). Pass human-readable names for screen readers via labels. Widgets already bound to the structure tree are skipped, so it is safe to run repeatedly. Untagged documents are out of scope (rebuild with the create tools' tagged: true, or run ensure_tagged first). For signed PDFs, preserveSignatures: true repairs while keeping the signatures intact (approval signatures only; certification signatures are refused).

allowBreakingSignatures.description: When the target is digitally signed (detected via /ByteRange), the default is an error. Set true to proceed, accepting that the signatures become invalid.

inputPath.description: Absolute path of the target PDF.

labels.description: Field name → human-readable alternate name (/TU) — what a screen reader speaks. Example: {"user.name": "氏名", "agree": "利用規約に同意する"}. Omitted fields fall back to the field name as /TU, reported in warnings. A nonexistent field name errors, listing every field name.

outputPath.description: Destination file path (absolute). When omitted, a base64 string is returned instead.

preserveSignatures.description: Edit a signed PDF via an incremental update (appending) without invalidating existing signatures. Default false. The original bytes are untouched, so /ByteRange holds. Changes beyond the certification (DocMDP) permission level are refused.

returnBase64.description: When true, include a base64 string in the result in addition to saving.

name: tag_form_fields
title: Tag Form Fields (PDF/UA repair)
